info.title: CueMem memory API
info.description: The /api/v1 memory API of `cuemem serve`, one endpoint per method of the Python SDK (cuemem.Memory); cuemem.MemoryClient is its Python client.

schema.title: Response Add Api V1 Memories Post

400.description: Invalid request (the SDK raised ValueError or TypeError).

402.description: The model provider's balance is exhausted.

403.description: The memory space is outside this API key's scope.

404.description: No such memory, run or space (KeyError), or outside this key's scope.

409.description: A concurrent write to the same run (ConcurrentWriteError).

422.description: Malformed request body or parameters (type ValueError).

429.description: Rate-limited by the model provider; see Retry-After.

502.description: The model or embedding provider failed.

503.description: The model provider is temporarily unavailable; see Retry-After.

DryRunResult.title: DryRunResult
DryRunResult.description: delete with dry_run=true: what would be deleted; nothing is.

type.title: Type
type.description: The SDK's exception type (KeyError, ValueError, TypeError or one of cuemem.errors); MemoryClient raises the same. null for 401 and for scope errors.

upstream_status.title: Upstream Status
upstream_status.description: The embedding provider's own status code (EmbeddingAPIError).

ExportDocument.title: ExportDocument
ExportDocument.description: A memory space as a portable file (cuemem/portable.py); POST /api/v1/import takes it.

status.title: Status
status.description: "current", or since when it is no longer true or corrected.

score.title: Score
score.description: Search only: for ranking, not a similarity.

FactItem.title: FactItem
FactItem.description: A fact. Times are ISO 8601 in the server's local time.

error.title: Error
error.description: The first line of the error.

retry_at.title: Retry At
retry_at.description: When the background worker retries (ISO 8601); null when it will not retry by itself (too many attempts, or no background worker): call consolidate.

ImageItem.title: ImageItem
ImageItem.description: An image; GET /api/v1/media/{id} returns the file (path is on the server).

errors.title: Errors
errors.description: The worker's last errors in this space.

StatusResult.title: StatusResult
